generatedProse.practice-connection:
You now have a way of approaching writing that will serve you in every module from here on. Each task you meet asks you to understand it, plan, draft, and revise. The stronger piece almost always comes from running that process on purpose rather than writing in one pass. The habit to keep is simple: read what the task is asking, get a draft down, then improve it before it counts.

That same habit carries into professional life. Wherever you are given work, judged against a standard, and asked to improve it, the people who do well are the ones who treat writing as a process. The cycle you have just learned to use is one you will rely on long after you graduate.
